% CAPTION DRAFT: Accuracy of the image-direction rule on the 450 fresh-fold images when the per-token evidence is combined in different ways (exploratory comparison). $^{\dagger}$Fixed before the fold was opened (unweighted sum and the frozen LRF); every other row was specified and scored after the preregistered Study~2 results, so ranks among them are post hoc. Bold: highest accuracy in the column; underlined: second highest; ties share the mark. The marks are a descriptive reading of one sample, not a test; differences with intervals are in supplement S-VII. Median, trimmed mean and trimmed at gate count (as many tokens trimmed per tail as half the gate flagged; the gate itself is not scored here) combine the same per-token evidence without a learned weight. Denoise: non-local-means denoising of the image before scoring (Study~1 setting), noise and JPEG only. CLIP and SigLIP (Table~\ref{tab:baselines}) and the fresh-fold hard-gate arm are not in this table (Addendum A6).
